review.intent_summary: Let local agent clients discover and invoke read-only analysis and evidence tools through an explicit MCP contract with interpretation guidance and safe error responses.

criteria.criterion: Tool discovery advertises analyze, list_findings, and get_evidence as read-only with input and output schemas.
Legacy initialization and modern stateless discovery return supported protocol metadata and interpretation guidance.
Analysis tool calls return structured content together with compact text.
Invalid tool input and unknown session run IDs return structured errors rather than fabricated results.

verification_evidence: Started installed .venv/Scripts/anomalyzer-mcp.exe and checked initialization, discovery guidance, and read-only tool listing.
Reviewed interpretation guidance covering readiness, overlapping findings, session limits, and caller-owned monitoring and actions.
remaining_gaps: The capability summary says three advertised tools; implementation and tests now advertise six, including all three required tools.
